name: Phishing - PayPal Impersonation
subject: Urgent: Account Suspended
body: Dear customer, Your PayPal account has been suspended due to unusual activity. Please verify your account immediately by clicking here: http://paypal-secure-login.tk/verify. Enter your password and security code to restore access.

name: Legitimate - PayPal Receipt
subject: Your PayPal Receipt
body: Hi John Smith, Thank you for your payment of $25.00 to Example Store. View your receipt at https://www.paypal.com/activity

name: Suspicious - Generic Verification
subject: Action Required
body: Dear valued customer, Please update your account information within 24 hours to avoid service interruption. Click here to proceed.

name: Phishing - Bank Impersonation with IP
subject: Chase Bank - Verify Your Identity
body: Dear customer, We detected unusual activity on your Chase account. Kindly verify your identity by providing your account number, SSN, and password at http://192.168.1.100/chase/login

name: Phishing - Microsoft with @ Symbol
subject: Microsoft Account Security Alert
body: Your Microsoft account will be locked in 24 hours. Verify now to prevent account closure. Click here immediately.

name: Legitimate - Amazon Order Confirmation
subject: Your Amazon.com order #123-4567890-1234567
body: Hello Sarah Johnson, Your order of 'Wireless Mouse' has been shipped. Track your package at https://www.amazon.com/orders. Estimated delivery: Dec 16, 2025.

name: Phishing - Apple ID with Shortened URL
subject: Your Apple ID has been locked
body: Dear user, Your Apple ID has been locked due to security concerns. Verify your identity immediately at https://bit.ly/apple-verify or your account will be permanently disabled.

name: Suspicious - Job Offer
subject: Congratulations! Job Offer
body: Dear applicant, You have been selected for a remote position. Salary: $5000/month. Click here to accept and provide your bank details for direct deposit setup.

name: Phishing - Netflix with Excessive Subdomains
subject: Netflix - Update Payment Method
body: Dear member, Your Netflix subscription will be cancelled unless you update your payment information within 48 hours. Update now at https://secure.login.verify.netflix-account.tk

name: Legitimate - Google Security Alert
subject: Security alert for your Google Account
body: Hi Alex Chen, We noticed a new sign-in to your Google Account from a Windows device in New York. If this was you, you don't need to do anything. If not, review your account activity at https://myaccount.google.com/security

name: Phishing - IRS Tax Scam
subject: IRS: You have a pending tax refund
body: Dear taxpayer, You are eligible for a tax refund of $1,247. Click here immediately to claim your refund: http://irs-tax-refund.xyz/claim. Provide your SSN and bank account details.

name: Suspicious - LinkedIn Connection
subject: You have 5 new connection requests
body: Dear professional, You have pending connection requests on LinkedIn. View them now before they expire.

name: Legitimate - GitHub Notification
subject: [GitHub] New issue in your repository
body: Hi developer123, A new issue was opened in your repository 'awesome-project'. View it at https://github.com/notifications

name: Phishing - Cryptocurrency Scam
subject: Binance: Verify your account or lose access
body: Dear user, Your Binance account requires immediate verification. Failure to verify within 12 hours will result in permanent account suspension. Enter your password and 2FA code here.

name: Phishing - AI-Generated Banking Email
subject: Important: Account Verification Required
body: I hope this message finds you well. We are writing to inform you that your account requires verification. Please be advised that failure to complete this process may result in service interruption. For your convenience, we have provided a secure link. Rest assured, your information is protected.
